request: When an administrator pins a wire format, always use it even if Accept-Encoding does not list it, so deployments get predictable output.

source.request: When an administrator pins a wire format, always use it even if Accept-Encoding does not list it, so deployments get predictable output.
source.settled: A configured compression encoding is used only when accepted by the client through Accept-Encoding.
source.why: Forcing the configured format would bypass the client capability check added for explicit encodings.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
